title: A typed parameter
prompt: Write `double`, whose parameter is hinted as an int and which returns the parameter times 2. doubled_int returns double(n).
starter:
func doubled_int(n: int) -> int:
	return n
hints: The hint sits inside the brackets after the parameter name.
